config.label: API key for HTTP authentication
config.description: API key for HTTP authentication. Required to bind the HTTP transport or the dashboard beyond loopback (0.0.0.0, a LAN address, a container): without it the server refuses to start

config.label: Path to a file whose trimmed contents are the API key (the secret-file pattern Docker and Kubernetes mount)
config.description: Path to a file whose trimmed contents are the API key (the secret-file pattern Docker and Kubernetes mount). Set this or IRIS_API_KEY, not both; further keys and rotation are security.apiKeys in config.json

config.label: Set to 1 to run a non-loopback bind with NO API key on purpose (lifts the startup refusal; the network is then your boundary)
config.description: Set to 1 to run a non-loopback bind with NO API key on purpose (lifts the startup refusal; the network is then your boundary)

config.label: SQLite database path
config.description: SQLite database path

config.label: Which SQLite driver holds the database: native (better-sqlite3, the default) or node (Node's built-in node:sqlite, Node 22
config.description: Which SQLite driver holds the database: native (better-sqlite3, the default) or node (Node's built-in node:sqlite, Node 22.13+). Unset: native, falling back to node when the native module cannot load

config.label: How long one trace search may read before it answers with the matches found so far, in milliseconds (50-60000, default 1000)
config.description: How long one trace search may read before it answers with the matches found so far, in milliseconds (50-60000, default 1000)

config.label: on (default) or off
config.description: on (default) or off. off keeps no full-text index of the traces: writes are cheaper, and a search reads the traces within its time budget

config.label: Log level: debug, info, warn, error
config.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error

config.label: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/
config.description: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/.iris)

config.label: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model
config.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

config.label: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model
config.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

config.label: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one LLM judge call (default 0
config.description: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one LLM judge call (default 0.25); max_cost_usd can lower it for a call, never raise it

config.label: A priced judge model; answers_the_ask then asks it on every evaluation with input, sending that input and output to the model's provider, and gates on its verdict (off by default)
config.description: A priced judge model; answers_the_ask then asks it on every evaluation with input, sending that input and output to the model's provider, and gates on its verdict (off by default)

config.label: What every judge call together may spend per UTC day, per tenant, in USD (default 1): the relevance judge, evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations
config.description: What every judge call together may spend per UTC day, per tenant, in USD (default 1): the relevance judge, evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations. Past it no judge call is made

config.label: The name of IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD before 0
config.description: The name of IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD before 0.21.0. Read when the new name is unset, and it then limits every judge call

config.label: Relevance judge calls one request may make (default 20)
config.description: Relevance judge calls one request may make (default 20)

config.label: on (default) replaces the PII and credentials no_pii flags before the relevance judge sends input and output to its provider; off sends them as they are
config.description: on (default) replaces the PII and credentials no_pii flags before the relevance judge sends input and output to its provider; off sends them as they are

config.label: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default); a tool argument can turn it off for a call, never on
config.description: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default); a tool argument can turn it off for a call, never on

config.label: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)
config.description: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)

config.label: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)
config.description: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)

config.label: MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000); only used with --transport http
config.description: MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000); only used with --transport http

config.label: OTLP/HTTP collector URL; when set, every stored trace is also exported as OpenTelemetry spans (best-effort, asynchronous)
config.description: OTLP/HTTP collector URL; when set, every stored trace is also exported as OpenTelemetry spans (best-effort, asynchronous)

config.label: Comma-separated domain allowlist for verify_citations fetches (only consulted when IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH is on); a tool argument can narrow it, never add to it
config.description: Comma-separated domain allowlist for verify_citations fetches (only consulted when IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH is on); a tool argument can narrow it, never add to it

config.label: The most one verify_citations call may spend on judge calls, in USD (default 1); max_cost_usd_total can lower it, never raise it
config.description: The most one verify_citations call may spend on judge calls, in USD (default 1); max_cost_usd_total can lower it, never raise it

config.label: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport
config.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport

config.label: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127
config.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1); only used with --transport http

config.label: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)
config.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)

config.label: The most array elements and object keys one input may hold before it is validated (default 100000): a tool call's arguments, and a dashboard or OTLP JSON request body
config.description: The most array elements and object keys one input may hold before it is validated (default 100000): a tool call's arguments, and a dashboard or OTLP JSON request body. A tool call over it gets an error result; a body, 413. OTLP protobuf has its own ceiling, one element per 5 bytes of the request size limit

config.label: The name of IRIS_MAX_INPUT_ELEMENTS before 0
config.description: The name of IRIS_MAX_INPUT_ELEMENTS before 0.21.0, read when the new name is unset

config.label: Bind host for the dashboard (default 127
config.description: Bind host for the dashboard (default 127.0.0.1); same as --dashboard-host

config.label: Comma-separated key=value headers sent with every OTLP export (for example an auth token for your collector)
config.description: Comma-separated key=value headers sent with every OTLP export (for example an auth token for your collector)

config.label: service
config.description: service.name resource attribute on exported spans (default iris-eval)

config.label: Timeout in milliseconds for each OTLP export request
config.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each OTLP export request

config.label: The receiver of the webhook that fires on a moment (docs/webhooks
config.description: The receiver of the webhook that fires on a moment (docs/webhooks.md); merged over notify.webhook in config.json

config.label: The signing key of that webhook (any string, or whsec_ + base64); the iris format refuses to run without one
config.description: The signing key of that webhook (any string, or whsec_ + base64); the iris format refuses to run without one
